producing_agent.identity: Cursor Grok 4.6 (cloud agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: The leaf-labeled EML grammar S → 1 | x | eml(S,S) has no 1-D integer invariant like degree. Exhaustive enumeration through 5 internal nodes matches 2^{k+1} C_k. Two equal-size trees disagree as functions on a registered positive grid. US-4′ is not tested.
decision: Accept the variable-x census if and only if labeled Catalan counts match and the registered size-1 pair disagrees at x=2. Do not promote US-4′. Finite-grid agreement is not function identity.

gates.EVS_ENUMERATION_COMPLETE: The number of trees with k internal nodes equals 2^{k+1} C_k for each k in {0,...,5}.
gates.EVS_SIZE_NOT_FUNCTION: eml(x,1)=exp(x) and eml(1,x)=e-ln(x) are both 1-internal and disagree at x=2.
gates.EVS_CONSTANT_EMBEDDING: The all-ones trees eml(1,eml(1,1)) and eml(eml(1,1),1) are constant in x and recover e-1 vs exp(e).
gates.EVS_GRID_DISCLOSED: The summary records that finite-grid agreement is not function identity.

kill_criteria.EVS_ENUMERATION_COMPLETE: Kill if any k in 0..5 has a count other than 2^{k+1} C_k.
kill_criteria.EVS_SIZE_NOT_FUNCTION: Kill if eml(x,1) and eml(1,x) agree at x=2 or fail their closed forms.
kill_criteria.EVS_CONSTANT_EMBEDDING: Kill if the all-ones size-2 pair fails e-1 vs exp(e) or depends on x.
kill_criteria.EVS_GRID_DISCLOSED: Kill if the disclosure string is missing.
kill_criteria.EVS_US4_PRIME_WITHHELD: Kill if the run claims US-4′ tested or passed.

audit_card.target_object: Full binary EML trees with each leaf labeled 1 or x, evaluated as real functions of x>0.
audit_card.decision: Accept or reject: labeled Catalan census through k=5; size is not a function invariant; US-4′ remains untested.
audit_card.representation: Dataclass trees; real eval; 10-decimal quantization of the 6-point positive grid for spectrum counts only.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Closed finite language fragment, no sampling.
material_assumptions: Leaf alphabet is {1,x}, so the constant grammar embeds.
The grid is positive; nonpositive x is out of the registered domain.
Rounded grid tuples are a computational clustering, not identity of functions.
No 1-D complete invariant is assumed or constructed.

objects.Tree: full binary trees; leaves in {1,x}; internal node denotes eml
objects.count: 2^{k+1} C_k trees with k internal nodes

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Evaluations are real or undefined. No units. Support is x in the registered positive grid.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: There exist two 1-internal trees whose values at x=2 differ (e^2 vs e-ln(2)). For each k in 0..5 the enumerated count equals 2^{k+1} C_k. The all-ones size-2 pair recovers e-1 vs exp(e). US-4′ is not a claim of this package.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Existential for the size-1 witness; universal for labeled Catalan counts on the registered bound.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Real evaluation; overflow/domain failures are undefined; rounding is not used for the size witness.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: The size witness uses closed forms, not rounded fiber ids.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Odrzywołek arXiv:2603.21852 for the operator. No degree-like invariant is assumed.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Pretty-print is a gauge. The grid is a registered representation, not the denotation.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: k=0 is {1,x}. At x=1, eml(x,1) and eml(1,x) both equal e; the witness uses x=2. All-ones trees are constant in x.

compute.sampling: exhaustive leaf-labeled trees with k<=5 internal nodes (3238 trees). Real eval on a 6-point positive grid.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as a leaf-labeled census through k=5 plus an exact same-size functional disagreement. Not US-4′. Not identity of functions. Not a 1-D invariant. Not the constant-only grammar.
